name: Blazing Passion
source:
This story follows Pierre, a cat in the grip of his daily routine. But an encounter will change his life by rekindling his flame, that of a past love that he would like to re-experience. The melancholy of a long-gone past can sometimes lead us down unexpected paths.

[From [url=https://neven-vn.itch.io/blazing-passion]Itch.io[/url]]
